experiment: M2: obtain the system default Metal device by MTLCopyAllDevices when it reports exactly one device (the same native object; probe receipt diagnostics/identity_probe.txt), keeping MTLCreateSystemDefaultDevice for any other count (m2/candidate.patch). One mechanism; control is main d57ab2877. Independent of M1.

host.label: apple-host
host.machine: Apple M3 (8 CPU cores, 10 GPU cores), 24 GiB unified memory
host.power: Battery Power, 34% at freeze, low-power mode off; power source must stay unchanged per window; every window's gate.json records the battery level and charging state before and after
host.sharedUse: desktop session with the external 120 Hz display, browser, terminal, agent sessions and a Codex desktop app renderer running; no computer-use or screen-capture session. Two 60 s idle measurements with no GPU run of this campaign: (1) idle GPU utilization median 8.5% (p90 19%), foreign CPU 17.7% of 8-core capacity (WindowServer, Codex renderer, Terminal, agent CLI); (2) just before freeze, idle GPU median 6.0% (p90 16%, max 26%), foreign CPU 25.3% (top: Python, Codex (Renderer), WindowServer, Terminal), of which one core was another session's Python scan job. Windows are scheduled by tools/wait_quiet.sh, so they start only after such a job leaves total CPU below 20%.

sourceCommit: d57ab2877 (library); harness, cohort tool and window tools as committed in e5c7b0130 (hashes below)
surface: dropin (public webgpu.h ABI); one harness source linked per provider, compiled with -DDOE_PHASE_BACKEND_METAL
workloadOrigin: unchanged amd-host C1 workloads; inputs manifest byte-identical to the amd-host and intel-host manifests (afe4e1d3...); independent CPU oracle on every iteration outside the timed interval

phases: identical to amd-host contract-c1.json; complete = compile + pipeline + resources + sum of every iteration's operation + teardown
statistics: per-pair ratio provider/dawn; median ratio, bootstrap 95% CI (10000 resamples, seed 20261029), provider-faster pair count

validity: every process status ok with all 32 iterations oracle-checked
every provider reports a Metal adapter that is not a CPU adapter
A/A: dawn-aa/dawn warm.operation median ratio within [0.95,1.05] and its CI95 contains 1, per workload
window gate (tools/mac_window.py) valid: power source and low-power mode unchanged, no thermal warning, idle GPU median <= 25% before and after, foreign CPU <= 20% of run-interval capacity
acceptance.mechanismRule: m2/main: setupNs and processWall CI95 upper < 1.0 on every workload, and every noRegress metric CI95 lower <= 1.05 on every workload. Correctness (recorded before freezing): on these exact rebuilt libraries, all 81 Metal physical clients give the same per-client result as main (correctness/physical-main-rebuild.tsv, correctness/physical-m2-rebuild.tsv; 58 pass, 16 abort on main too, 1 needs checker arguments, 6 GNU-only). The owner checks recorded in contract-m2.json ran on the same source, not on these binaries.
acceptance.invalidWindows: an invalid window is retained, never used for the verdict, and rerun fresh once under the unchanged contract
acceptance.claimBoundary: A pass accepts the mechanism for the Metal C runtime on apple-host only; it does not by itself make a scoped win against Dawn and says nothing about Vulkan or D3D12.

relation: New prospective experiment with the m2 rules. It does not reinterpret contract-m2.json, which keeps its own status as recorded in README.md.
rebuild: The previous scratch tree was deleted. Rebuilding the same sources reproduced the harness binaries, the Dawn library, libdoe_compiler.dylib and the inputs manifest byte for byte, but not libwebgpu_doe_c.dylib (main, m1 or m2): the native Makefile builds with -O2 -g and ld64 writes each object's modification time into the debug map, so two clean builds of the same tree differ. These builds set ZERO_AR_DATE=1, which zeroes those times; two clean builds of d57ab2877 then gave identical bytes. Code and flags are otherwise unchanged. Because the frozen library hashes cannot be reproduced, this is a new prospective experiment.
gpuLock: Every timed window runs under `flock /tmp/doe-gpu-timing.lock`, the host-wide lock shared with other agents' Metal correctness and timing runs, held for that window only; tools/wait_quiet.sh schedules outside the lock.
gateLimits: Unchanged from b2: idle GPU median <= 25% before and after, foreign CPU <= 20% of run-interval capacity (tools/mac_window.py, hash below). Checked against the measured idle load in host.sharedUse before freezing.
